exercise.rubric: <font color="#000000">Match the words and their definitions.</font>

questions.sentence: <font color="#000000">When you do work outside your usual hours and you get paid more. </font>[overtime]
<font color="#000000">When your employer permanently increases your salary. </font>[pay rise]
<font color="#000000">Money that you have borrowed and need to pay back. </font>[debts]
<font color="#000000">To choose someone for a job or a role. </font>[appoint]
<font color="#000000">When both sides reach an agreement by changing their positions. </font>[compromise]
<font color="#000000">The location or place for something. </font>[venue]
<font color="#000000">Any Other Business: extra discussion points on an agenda. </font>[AOB]
<font color="#000000">When people lose their jobs and receive a special, final payment. </font>[redundancy]
